usedFor: Recruit CRM holds candidates and clients, and HubSpot receives each new contact through “Create or Update Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “Contact Created” in Recruit CRM, then “Create or Update Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: A new Recruit CRM contact is added to HubSpot, or merged into the existing one by email.

watchOut: “Create or Update Contact” works by email, so “Contact Created” in Recruit CRM needs an email to match.
